no_go_theorem.statement: Branch C full-carrier ZI-COV(i) is foreclosed on the inherited Burnol/Sonine pulled-evaluator carrier, under the standard log-Mellin/Fourier U_infty normalization and lambda=1, because explicit legal generators and zeta-zero labels have nonzero matrix elements L_{rho,0}(G)=<M_zeta G, P_infty y_{rho,0}> separated from numerical error.
no_go_theorem.scope: Forecloses only the Branch C full-carrier ZI-COV(i) route. Step 170 zero-free output subclass remains valid. The generic claim is diagnostic-generic across multiple tested zeros and legal generators, not an open-dense theorem on the whole legal class.
no_go_theorem.nonclaim: Does not prove RH; does not close Xi_BC; does not close Branch A, Branch B, or Hecke branches; does not extend beyond unitarily-equivalent normalizations.
no_go_theorem.proof_sketch: Step 173 supplies the operational identity for P_infty. Step 174 rewrites L_{rho,0}(G) as -I_sinc minus the PSWF sum. Step 175 gives a nonzero certified numerical datum at (rho_1,G_star). Step 176 gives three further nonzero certified numerical data points. If full-carrier ZI-COV(i) held, P_infty M_zeta G=M_zeta A_infty G would vanish at each zeta zero for regular legal output A_infty G; the observed nonzero L values contradict that route. Under unitarily equivalent normalizations, inner products and zero/nonzero status are preserved, so only magnitudes can change.
